newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Credit Suisse plans alliance with Volpe.
newsitem.headline: Credit Suisse plans alliance with Volpe.

text.p: Credit Suisse Group said its Credit Suisse First Boston unit plans a strategic alliance with San Francisco-based investment bank Volpe Brown Whelan & Co which includes CSFB making a "significant investment" in Volpe.
A CSFB spokesman in Zurich could provide no details, but according to an article in the Friday edition of the Wall Street Journal, analysts valued the stake at $25 million.
The alliance is aimed at providing service to coprorate and institutional clients in the global healthcare and and technology industries, the CSFB spokesman said.
It would include the creation of a specialist merchant banking fund, managed by Volpe, targeted to these industries. CSFB will be the lead investor. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
